learning_outcomes.text: Describe the fundamental concepts of general linguistics and correlate them with elements of a particular language.
Describe and classify the main concepts and linguistic theories regarding the phonetic, lexical, syntactic, semantic, and pragmatic system of the English language.
Distinguish linguistic standards and norms and specific terminology for different professional contexts in English.
Identify the linguistic and terminological particularities of different types of text (commercial and industrial documentation, personal documents, journalism, fiction, governmental documents, etc.).
Describe relevant elements for the culture and civilization of the peoples whose language is being studied.
Apply methodological and theoretical models specific to the study of natural languages.
Apply the main linguistic concepts and theories in producing texts in English.
Apply standards and norms in the English language.

Correct texts in the language of instruction of the study program, translate different types of texts from one language to another, preserving the meaning and nuances of the original text, without additions/modifications/omissions.
Contextualize the English language in its cultural environment, adequately interpret cultural references, and adopt a broader perspective on cultural diversity.
Translate orally or in writing from English to Romanian and vice versa in areas of broad, semi-specialized interest.
Draft and edit scientific texts, academic scientific papers on various topics, avoiding incorrect behaviors such as falsification or plagiarism.
Use appropriate expressions and words in producing texts in the English language.
Autonomously use specific terminology from different professional contexts in English and identify the appropriate terminology to be used.
Coherently and argumentatively express opinions and analyses about culture and civilization, in discussions, essays, or presentations, adequately using specialized terminology.
Efficiently use glossaries and dictionaries (paper or electronic) as well as databases.

Respect ethical principles, norms, and values in the correct and timely execution of professional tasks, by adopting a rigorous, efficient, and responsible work strategy in making decisions to solve problems.
Integrate into the work group and apply effective relationship and teamwork techniques in multidisciplinary teams.
Continuously inform and document themselves in their own field of activity by adequately using effective lifelong learning methods and techniques.
Elaborate professional projects in the field of engineering.

syllabus_topics: Grammar in use: Nouns, Adjectives, Adverbs, Prepositions, Verb tenses
Vocabulary in use: Daily life, People, Environment, Social interaction
teaching_methods: Debates based on Power Point presentations
Learning through discovery models (experiment, demonstration, modeling)

assessment_methods.method: Seminar (active participation, individual/team assignments, project/oral presentation)

assessment_rules: Conditions for passing include participation in the seminar, assimilation of taught notions, and passing the final test. The final evaluation result is obtained by considering the scores and weights allocated to each activity. Whole grades from 10 to 1 will be awarded, with a grade of 5 certifying the acquisition of minimal learning outcomes and the granting of corresponding study credits.
bibliography: Murphy, R. (2019). English Grammar in Use (5th ed.). Cambridge University Press.
Ibbotson, M. (2008). Cambridge English for Engineering [Student's Book with Audio CDs]. Cambridge University Press.
Gangalakshmi, C. Rathika, B. & Saranraj, L. (2023). Professional English for Engineers (2nd ed.). Cengage India.

degree: Inginerie Mecanică (licență, 4 ani / 240 ECTS) - Facultatea de Mecanică
